propositions: Compiled state must track plan_review_phase (planning|execution) distinct from execution_mode, updated only by winning STATUS targets: open→planning, in_progress→execution, other→preserve.
Pre-upgrade snapshots without phase field must bootstrap planning for open/idea status and execution for all other known statuses, emitting structured INFO once per ticket.
Execution-phase plan reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 priority-floor blocking policy in Pass-3, while planning-phase reviews use unmodified thresholds.
Manifest format must emit review-phase and optional priority-floor in fixed order with one-space-separated tokens; legacy attestations without these lines parse as planning/None.
Re-sign must parse recorded phase/floor from v2 sidecar JSON, refuse incompatible or malformed variants, and build manifest from recorded values rather than inferred phase.

Signing must collect immutable generation before LLM/probe, retry at most three times on HEAD instability, require exact pre-LLM generation and clean HEAD under write lock, and never write on collection/LLM failure.
